description: This Java source file defines the class RetrievePolicyIdResponse, which represents a response to a RetrievePolicyId command. The class is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.query package and extends AbstractCommandResponse, implementing ThingQueryCommandResponse.
